cultural.vision_reason: Studio cabinet-card portrait of Kiowa Chief Sleeping Wolf and his wife, both in identifiable Kiowa dress with braided hair, peace medal, blanket, shawl, and jewelry, documenting traditional attire and personal adornment.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); cabinet card
physical.classification: photographic print (black and white); cabinet card
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white); cabinet card, studio portrait of Sleeping Wolf (Gui-kati), a  Kiowa Chief, standing next to his seated wife; he wears his hair braided on one side, with a strip of wool, a cloth tie around his neck, a peace medal, a cloth shirt and vest and wool blanket around his waist; she wears ear ornaments, a pocket watch suspended from a chain on her neck, a cloth top, bracelets, rings, a woven shawl and woven blanket around her waist; Washington DC, United States of America.
